verdict.rationale: n8n's own materials describe a visual canvas for building multi-step workflows, and one hands-on report says a manager with zero programming skills built a complex backend with it. Other users report that non-programmers struggle with data transformation and often need SQL, JSON or XML parsing, so the no-code part of the story has real limits. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a fully no-code path for data transformation and mapping, consistent evidence that non-technical ops users can finish multi-step workflows without code, detailed visual-editor docs beyond marketing taglines.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: Combine a visual canvas with custom code, run it self-hosted or in the cloud, and connect to 1500+ integrations.
Build visually, go deep with code, connect to anything.
Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
Our manager with zero programming skills was able to build a quite complex backend using postgres and REST APIs, with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks.
I think it's great for less-technical users when compared to windmill.
